Four inventions over time.id: Empat penemuan dari masa ke masa

desc.id: Garis waktu empat penemuan: roda, percetakan dengan balok yang bisa dipindah, ponsel, dan lampu tenaga surya. Masing-masing diberi label tentang apa yang diubahnya.

About 5,500 years ago.note: Matches the reading ("Sekitar 5.500 tahun lalu"); Indonesian thousands point.

1000s to 1400s.note: Too wide for one line between the two break marks, so split over two lines like the first date ("1000-an sampai" / "1400-an"). Reading uses "tahun 1400-an".

Mesopotamia.note: Place name, as in the reading.

China, Korea, Germany.note: Indonesian spellings, as in the reading.

Timeline of four inventions: the wheel,.back: A timeline of four inventions: the wheel, printing with movable blocks, the mobile phone, and the solar lamp. Each is labelled with what it changed.
